The '''Gatekeeper''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] user interface of the [[Chamber of Speech]] in the ruins of the temple-city of [[Kaleth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="TOR" /> An ancient relic of the [[Je'daii Order]]&mdash;the predecessors of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="NOP" />&mdash;the chamber stored knowledge and information about the planet's past and the Jedi's history. After the planet was abandoned following the [[Force Wars]], the chamber fell into disuse, and the Gatekeeper shut down for over twenty thousand years.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLS}}
The Chamber and the Gatekeeper were reactivated, however, around [[3643 BBY]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who had been sent by the failed Padawan [[Do Zonn]] to investigate the ruins. Analyzing its systems, the Gatekeeper realized that the Chamber was undergoing a cascade failure and could not be repaired, so it offered to fulfill its duty and give the one who had awoken it any knowledge that the Gatekeeper could recover. Offered a choice between the story of [[Avamarivash]] the Warrior-Poet and [[Maravada]] the Silent, two leaders of the ancient Jedi, the Padawan chose to save the history of the philosopher Maravada over the womanizing warrior Avamarivash. Transferring the data to a [[Data crystal/Legends|data crystal]], the Gatekeeper said goodbye to the young Jedi just before its systems failed completely.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}
